sentences.text: **Scheme Brief Description:** The "Paduke Kuteera Scheme" provides roadside cobblers engaged in repair work or footwear production with a steel-made kiosk (Paduke Kuteera) and a tool kit free of cost. The unit cost of each Kuteera is ₹1,25,000, and the scheme includes a signage board display arrangement.
**Who is this for:** Individual; Category: Business & Entrepreneurship; Sector: Setting up / start-up / entrepreneurship

**Detailed Description:** The "Paduke Kuteera Scheme" was implemented by Karnataka Leather Industries Development Corporation Ltd, Department of Social Welfare, Govt of Karnataka. The scheme aims to provide a steel-made kiosk (Paduke Kuteera) and a tool kit free of cost to roadside cobblers engaged in repair work or footwear production. The scheme promotes self-employment by offering proper infrastructure and resources to cobblers.
**Benefits / Assistance:** - **Free Paduke Kuteera made of steel material with signage board display arrangement.** - **Free Tool Kit.**  **NOTE:** Unit cost for each Kuteera is ₹1,25,000/-.

**Application Process:** > **Registration Process:** **Step-01:** Visit the official [Seva Sindhu Portal](https://sevasindhu.karnataka.gov.in/Sevasindhu/English). **Step-02:** Choose "New Users Register Here" and fill in your Aadhaar Number and the Captcha code. **Step-03:** An OTP will be sent to your Aadhaar-linked mobile number. Enter the OTP to continue. **Step-04:** Once your DigiLocker account is created, click "Allow" to proceed. **Step-05:** Fill out your email ID, mobile number, create a password, and enter the captcha, then click "Submit". **Step-06:** You will receive OTPs on both your email and mobile number. Enter both OTPs and select "Validate". **Step-07:** Once validated, a confirmation message will indicate your registration is successful.  > **Applying for a Scheme:** **Step-01:** Go to [Seva Sindhu Portal](https://sevasindhu.karnataka.gov.in/Sevasindhu/English) and select "Department & Services". **Step-02:** Select department "Social Welfare Department" and click on the scheme "Padhuke Kuteera Scheme" **Step-03:** Click "Apply Online" and enter your registered email ID/mobile number and the OTP. **Step-04:** Select the scheme and provide your personal, address, and banking details as required. **Step-05:** Once submitted, you will receive an Application ID. You can use this ID to track your application status on the portal.
**Contacts & Authorities:** Implementing agency: Karnataka Leather Industries Development Corporation Ltd; Nodal Department: Social Welfare Department
**Tags:** Financial Assistance, Artisans, Self-employment, Scheduled Caste
